next_review_at.description: SM-2: When this node is next due for spaced review. NULL = not yet scheduled.

review_interval_days.description: SM-2: Current inter-review interval in days. Starts at 1.

ease_factor.description: SM-2: Ease factor (EF). Default 2.50. Min 1.30. Adjusts per review quality.

review_count.description: SM-2: Total successful reviews. Controls interval growth curve.

consecutive_correct_streak.description:
Consecutive correct answers on this node without interruption.
   Resets to 0 on wrong answer. Used to apply diminishing returns:
   contribution_weight = 1 / (streak ^ 0.7). Prevents grinding easy questions.

highest_difficulty_correct.description:
Highest taxonomy_tree.difficulty (1-4) this user has correctly answered on this node.
   Score ceiling of 70% applies if no Level 3+ questions have been answered correctly
   across all nodes. Updated only on correct answers.

has_bloom_apply_correct.description:
True once user correctly answers an apply-level question on this node.
   One-way flag ÔÇö never resets. Used for Bloom cognitive ceiling enforcement.

has_bloom_analyze_correct.description:
True once user correctly answers an analyze-level question on this node.
   One-way flag ÔÇö never resets. Used for Bloom cognitive ceiling enforcement.

distinct_questions_seen.description:
Count of unique question_ids answered (any result) for this node.
   < 5 ÔåÆ node contributes at 40% weight (thin_coverage state in heatmap)
   5-9 ÔåÆ node contributes at 85% weight
   >= 10 ÔåÆ node contributes at 100% weight
   Prevents question bank memorization at low question counts.

status.description:

   draft     = being authored, invisible to students
   review    = submitted for SME approval
   published = live and visible to students
   archived  = retired (prefer is_active=false for temporary removal)
   CRITICAL: A wrong reveal_text trains incorrect exam answers. Review gate is mandatory.

   NOT official PRC-published weights. Use for UX weighting guidance only.

is_cross_ref_only.description:
TRUE for LEA-LAWS subject node and all descendants (topics + subtopics).
   When TRUE:

   - Wiki articles CAN be created for this node
   - This node is EXCLUDED from student-facing heatmap mastery display
   LEA-LAWS carries zero exam weight. Its law questions appear distributed across Areas A, B, C.

deprecated_at.description:

   reference them historically. Deprecated nodes are excluded from all live queries
   via WHERE deprecated_at IS NULL.
